worked_solution:
The word "or" is represented by the symbol "$\lor$".

So, the sentence reads

\[
\underbrace{2+3 \vphantom{p}\textrm{ equals }\vphantom{p} 5 }_A \quad \underbrace{\vphantom{p}\textbf{or}}_{\lor} \quad 
\underbrace{\pi \vphantom{p}\textrm{ is rational} }_B,
\]

that is, $A \lor B.$
